hook: Write Elixir, get an FPGA circuit

beats.say: FPGA circuits are usually written register by register in Verilog or VHDL. Elixir HLS generates that hardware from ordinary Elixir functions instead.
A function defined with defhls still runs on the CPU, and also becomes a circuit. Each circuit is simulated against its Elixir function and used only if the results match.
Version 0.1.0 is an early first release that synthesizes integer functions, with types like u32 setting the bit width. It builds on CIRCT and Icarus Verilog.
